name: Mini Glossier You Wardrobe Kit
description: Four fragrances, endless versions of you. The Mini Glossier You Wardrobe Kit includes miniature You, Doux, Fleur and Soie, dressed up in limited-edition mosaic-inspired packaging. A little fragrance wardrobe made for gifting, traveling, layering and trying something new this holiday season!

name: Glossier You Duo
description: Your signature scent, with a little holiday spirit. The Glossier You Duo pairs two sizes of our beloved Glossier You, one for your Top Shelf and one for taking everywhere the season takes you. Finished in limited-edition mosaic-inspired packaging that’s ready to gift, no wrapping required!

name: Glossier You Doux
description: Glossier You Doux is a soft and serene woody fragrance that opens with Sweet Violet, followed by a precious blend of woody Palo Santo, Frankincense and smoky Myrrh—heightened by a warm, musky base driven by Ambrox. Doux is a skin-scent enhancer that wears close to the skin and true to you, never overpowering your unique scent—because you are the final ingredient.

name: Glossier You
description: Glossier You is a soft, warm and familiar skin-scent enhancing fragrance. Sparkling Pink Pepper opens into earthy Iris, settling into a strong, slightly-sweet base of Ambrette and Ambrox that wears close to skin–so it smells a little different on everyone!

name: Boy Brow
description: Inspired by the flexible formula of mustache pomade, Boy Brow visibly defines, thickens and shapes for face-framing brows in seconds. A creamy, conditioning formula and a precision brush coats even the smallest and finest hairs for a soft, flexible hold that won’t stiffen or flake. Available in a range of subtly-tinted shades that seamlessly blend in with your natural hairs plus Clear (that won’t leave a trace).

name: Balm Dotcom
description: Our cult-favorite, do-everything lip balm. Swipe on for hydration you can feel and taste with a formula rich in antioxidants and natural emollients to nourish dryness.

name: Fragrance Duo
description: Build your dream fragrance set with this customizable duo. Simply pick two full-size bottles from our skin-scent enhancing Glossier You Collection!

name: In A New York Minute Set
description: Get ready in a New York minute with Balm Dotcom, Boy Brow, Cloud Paint Plush Blush and Lip Line. Four makeup must-haves for a seamless look you can put together while on the subway or in the back of a moving cab.

name: Travel Spray + Balm
description: The ultimate on-the-go duo: Balm Dotcom for instant nourishment and Glossier You Travel Spray for fragrance touch-ups. Ideal for any handbag or makeup bag.

name: Fragrance Two Ways
description: Build your dream fragrance set with this customizable duo. Simply pick one full-size bottle for your Top Shelf, and a Travel Spray for easy, on-the-go touch-ups!

name: Lip Line
description: A creamy, medium-coverage lip pencil that enhances your natural shape and tone. Available in an array of true-to-lip, nipple-matched shades.

name: Cloud Paint Plush Blush
description: A pillowy-soft powder blush that blends and builds seamlessly for a soft-matte flush. Available in a wide range of colors inspired by New York City sunsets.

name: Cloud Paint Blush
description: A collection of seamless cheek colors in both blush and bronzer shades inspired by golden hour sunsets, so natural it’s like your skin made it. Easy to wear and apply, each shade is sheer enough to blend and layer without going overboard.

name: Cloud Paint Bronzer
description: A collection of seamless cheek colors in both blush and bronzer shades inspired by golden hour sunsets, so natural it’s like your skin made it. Easy to wear and apply, each shade is sheer enough to blend and layer without going overboard.

name: The Glossier Icons
description: Three Glossier best-sellers for your everyday, one very cute bag. Boy Brow for fluffy, groomed brows, Balm Dotcom for instant lip nourishment, and our viral Glossier You Travel Spray for an ultra-personal scent. Zip them inside our Pink Mini Beauty Bag and you're set!

name: Fragrance Trio
description: Build your dream fragrance set with this customizable trio. Simply pick three Travel Sprays from our skin-scent enhancing Glossier You Collection!

name: The Skincare Icons
description: Three steps, every day. Start and end the day with our conditioning face wash, Milky Jelly Cleanser. Lock in moisture with our cocooning recovery cream, After Baume. And keep your skin protected from the sun with our lightweight SPF50 Invisible Shield sunscreen.

name: Futuredew
description: A skincare–makeup hybrid that’s a one-step shortcut to the glow of a 12-step routine. Think instant dewy, sun-kissed glow, plus smoother-looking texture with continued use. Packed with hydrating heavy-hitters, nourishing oils, and powerful plant-based extracts, it leaves skin gleamy, well-moisturized, and visibly brighter for up to 12 hours.

name: Glossier You Rêve
description: Glossier You Rêve is a lush, dreamy gourmand fragrance that opens with rich Buttercream, followed by an addictive center of Plum Butter, Toasted Almond, Iris and creamy white Sandalwood—heightened by a warm, musky base driven by Ambrox. Rêve is a skin-scent enhancer that wears close to the skin and true to you, never overpowering your unique scent—because you are the final ingredient.

name: Glossier You Soie
description: You know that feeling you get on vacation, when you’re standing on the beach at dusk? Your skin is still salty and warm, the air is starting to cool, and anything seems possible. That’s Glossier You Soie. A skin-scent enhancing sensual and creamy solar fragrance. Bright, cool Bergamot opens into a blend of Rice Milk, Tiare Water and Evening Jasmine, grounded by a warm, musky base of Ambrox that wears close to skin—so it smells a little different on everyone!

name: Glossier You Fleur
description: An airy and luminous floral blend that opens with a textured Mineral Salt Accord, followed by a heart of Osmanthus, Ylang Ylang, Apricot Skin and Cashmeran. Complete with a warm, musky base driven by Ambrox. Fleur is a skin-scent enhancer that wears close to the skin and true to you, never overpowering your unique scent—because you are the final ingredient.

name: Glossier You Discovery Kit
description: A trial-sized collection featuring four of our Glossier You fragrances: You, Doux, Reve, and Fleur. The Glossier You Collection is a collection of skin-scent enhancers that are designed to be layered and played with.

name: Embroidered Pink Hoodie
description: The cozy essential you know and love, refreshed with just the right modern touch. A slightly cropped waistband gives it an easy, updated shape, while the G-quad patch, embroidered logo, and Smile Wave motif add a bit of personality in all the right places. It’s the forever classic—just a little more current, a little more considered, and made to be worn on repeat!

name: Lash Slick
description: Our best-selling mascara visibly lengthens and lifts lashes for a baby extensions effect. More: ‘Your lashes look good’ than ‘your mascara looks good’. The weightless, flexible formula will give you natural-looking lift and length with teeny-tiny fibers that coat each individual lash from root to tip for maximum definition. Come for better-looking lashes, stay for the long-wearing, water-resistant (not waterproof) formula that stays in place for up to 12 hours—without smudging or flaking*. *Tested on Lash Slick in Black only.

name: Ultralip
description: Cocoon your lips with this luxe, one-step lipstick. Formulated with the rich moisture of a balm, the sheen of a gloss and the buildable color of a lip tint, this staple is bound to be your new obsession.

name: The Face Kit
description: Two makeup icons for natural coverage. Start by applying with our ultra-thin, breathable Perfecting Skin Tint all over the face and spot correct with our buildable Stretch Balm Concealer. The result? A glowy, looks-like-you base that feels like you’ve got nothing on.

name: Boy Brow Duo
description: Stock up on Boy Brow and save with a duo of our best-selling eyebrow pomade. Designed to fill, fluff, shape and groom, it gives brows soft, flexible hold and natural-looking fullness in just a few swipes. Keep one at home, one in your bag—or never risk running out of your perfect brow routine!

name: Balm Dotcom Trio
description: Treat your lips to a trio of our moisturizing lip balms with our original, cult-favorite formula. Pick any three tubes to satisfy your shade and flavor preferences.

name: Milky Jelly Cleanser
description: A pH-balanced gel-cream cleanser that’s suitable for all skin types. Formulated with gentle, conditioning ingredients, this cleanser dissolves dirt, oil and makeup while leaving skin soft and nourished–never stripped.

name: Invisible Shield SPF50
description: Lightweight and undetectable, this SPF50 broad-spectrum chemical sunscreen protects against UVA/UVB rays, leaves no greasy residue or white cast, and even primes skin for smooth makeup application.

name: Perfecting Skin Tint
description: An undetectable wash of color that evens out skin’s appearance but won’t hide your freckles, cake your pores, or cover you up. The ultra-thin, breathable formula leaves you with a smooth, dewy finish that lets your skin shine through. Diamond Powder gives a brightening, soft-focus effect and minimizes the appearance of pores, while Glycerin acts as a moisture lock to attract hydration. Comes in 12 super sheer shades.

name: Stretch Balm Concealer
description: The same concealer you know and love, now available in 32 foundation-matching shades. Buildable coverage formulated to camouflage skin realities like dark circles, blemishes, and redness—but always look like skin with a dewy glowy finish.

name: Stretch Fluid Foundation
description: An 89% skincare-based, gel-cream foundation that leaves skin looking moisturized with a natural-to-you finish. Formulated to fuse with skin (never cake on-top), to blend seamlessly and wear up to 12 hours.

name: Crème de You
description: Our iconic Glossier You fragrance, now in a fast absorbing, luxurious body crème with a soft, silky, delicately scented finish.

name: Mini Beauty Bag
description: Small but mighty, this beloved bag keeps all your can’t-leave-home-without-them essentials within reach. With one main compartment and a zipper closure, the Mini Beauty Bag allows you to experience the convenience of our classic Beauty Bag wherever you may go. Now in two fun colors—iconic red and soft pink.

name: The Beauty Bag
description: This bag is the ultimate home for your beauty routine. It’s tall enough to fit all of your essentials (even full-size skincare!), but still easily slips into your tote. The coated cotton material means you won’t have to worry about spills or splashes, with a removable snap-button interior pouch, and plenty of extra pockets to keep you organized—so you’re never stuck digging for your favorite products.

name: The No-Makeup Makeup Kit
description: Your shortcut to looking like the best version of yourself. The No-Makeup Makeup Kit pairs three everyday icons: Lash Slick for long, defined lashes that won’t budge, Boy Brow for soft, fluffy brows with flexible hold, and Stretch Balm Concealer for medium, dewy coverage wherever you want it. Together, they create a fresh-faced look that enhances, never hides.

name: Errand Bag
description: Long day ahead? We’ve got you covered. This roomy, super durable limited edition woven tote is ready for wherever the day takes you—planned or not. With a spacious body, a handy pocket for your essentials, and Glossier Pink branded straps in two sizes, it’s built for grocery runs, laundry days, park hangs, those “I’ll just swing by for a minute” plans that turn into staying out way too late!

name: Lip Gloss
description: A comfortable lip gloss with a glassy finish and just the right amount of sticky. The applicator delivers instant shine with one swipe.

name: Boy Brow Arch
description: Shape and define brows with a 2-in-1 custom tip shape offering a precision edge for hair-like flicks and flat edge to fill sparse areas.

name: Hand Cream
description: A supercharged cream that helps you keep moisture on hand. The palm-sized pod with a 360º easy-to-squeeze curve and click-to-close cap makes moisturizing on the go quick and convenient, while securing against spills. The fast-absorbing formula nourishes dry skin without ever getting greasy and uses a “second skin” matrix to lock in moisture.

name: Deodorant
description: 2024 Allure Best of Beauty Award-Winner. Refillable, pit-friendly and aluminum-free, our deo features a skin-conditioning Coconut Oil base and moisturizing ingredients like Superfruit Elderberry Extract, Magnesium Hydroxide and Potato Starch that keep you smelling great and feeling dry all day. Formulated without aluminum, baking soda, exfoliating acids or water—aka things that can cause bad odor, disrupt the skin’s pH level and cause irritation—our Deodorant keeps it gentle (but mighty!) with ingredients that work for every underarm.

name: Glossier Candles
description: Light up and wind down with some of our signature Glossier scents. Made with a vegan, non-paraffin wax blend of soy and coconut, our candles have a burn time of up to 45 hours. The best part? Once it’s burnt through, you can reuse the glass vessel to store makeup, pencils or whatever your heart desires!

name: Generation G
description: A fragrance-free, buildable, sheer-matte lipstick with a perfectly diffused flush of color. Inspired by the makeup artist trick of blotting lipstick after application, one swipe glides on smooth and even (no mirror needed!) for a buildable, soft-edged, just-kissed look. Give your natural lips a little something extra, with shades Malt, Fuzz, Cake, and Leo, or go for vivid Punch, Zip, Jam and Crush to really grab the attention.

name: Lip Glaze
description: A refreshing everyday essential for a sheer-glaze of color and lightweight, non-sticky shine. Its nourishing formula melts instantly on the lips, delivering long-lasting care and up to 12-hour hydration for smoother-looking lips. Wear it on its own or layered with your favorite lip products.

name: Ultralip Duo
description: Shop and save when you pair our buildable, ultra-nourishing, high-shine lipstick.

name: Balm + Line Duo
description: Pucker up to this limited edition lip combo. Start by lining your lips with our seamless enhancing pencil, Lip Line, and finish off the look with a few swipes of our nourishing Balm Dotcom.

name: After Baume
description: A daily moisture barrier recovery cream perfect for very dry and/or sensitive skin. The buttery, cocooning cream formulated with plant-based moisture magnets, Glycerin and Cupuaçu Butter, helps dry skin bounce back and lock in hydration for up to 24 hours.

name: Body Hero Dry-Touch Oil Mist
description: Escape into luxury with the Body Hero you love, in a transportive dry-touch mist. With an intoxicating Orange Blossom Neroli scent, this ultra-fine body oil packed with Sea Fennel Extract and a blend of three antioxidant-rich oils—Sunflower Seed, Grapeseed, and Oat—instantly moisturizes while smoothing and evening skin tone and improving all over radiance. The formula absorbs fast with zero residue, stickiness, or awkward naked dry-down time (so you can put your clothes on quicker). Plus, the sparkling, subtle aroma lingers just enough for that just-got-back-from vacation scent and glow.

name: You Look Good Pet Set
description: Your dog is already the cutest one at the park. Might as well dress the part. This walk-ready set includes our limited-edition You Look Good Leash, You Look Good Collar, Smile Wave Pet Waste Bags, plus a matching dispenser (already stocked with a roll) for serving looks from first lap to final potty break.

name: The Curbside Set
description: Every good walk starts with the essentials. This walk-ready duo pairs our Pet Waste Bag Dispenser—already pre-packed with one roll of bags—with an additional eight unscented rolls of Smile Wave Pet Waste Bags, so you’re always prepared for whatever the sidewalk throws your way. Cute, convenient and deeply appreciated by your neighborhood.

name: You Look Good Leash
description: Designed to match our You Look Good Collar, this sturdy limited edition essential is made for your furry friend’s favorite part of the day: the walk. Equipped with a D-ring for your waste bag dispenser, it’s wrapped in an all-over “You Look Good” mantra print—bringing a little extra cheer to every step, sniff and stop along the way. Because they lead the way, you just come prepared!

name: You Look Good Collar
description: Designed to match our You Look Good Leash, this stylish, sturdy, and adjustable limited edition collar is made for the dog (or cat!) you love doing life with. Wrapped in an all-over“You Look Good” mantra print, it brings a little extra charm to their daily lives—at home, on the couch and out in the world. Finished with a secure-locking buckle for peace of mind, so they can do their thing and you don’t have to think twice about it.

name: Pet Waste Bag Dispenser
description: We’ve officially upgraded the least glamorous part of pet parenting! Meet our first-ever limited edition pet waste bag dispenser. Designed for the reality that keeping things clean is part of the (puppy) love. Adorned with our signature G-logo, this Sunset Pink accessory clips to our You Look Good Leash and fits our Smile Wave Pet Waste Bags perfectly.

name: Smile Wave Pet Waste Bags
description: A cute companion to our Pet Bag Dispenser, this stylish limited edition roll of unscented Glossier pink pet waste bags features our iconic Smile Wave Icon and Glossier logo. Not glamorous, but absolutely necessary—these easy-tear bags are here for the “oh okay, we’re doing this now” moments. Compact, reliable, and always ready when your dog decides it’s time!

name: Glossier You Solid
description: Glossier You, the ultimate personal fragrance, in the ultimate personal format—a refillable, pocket and travel-friendly, solid compact. The solid formula is softer and more intimate, with an alcohol-free, anhydrous wax base that quite literally melts into skin and holds the fragrance close, almost like it’s a part of you. Instead of being surrounded by a cloud of scent, you get friendly reminders throughout the day when you catch a whiff of your wrist or neck of your sweater—creamy, warm, sparkling notes of ambrox, ambrette, musk, iris root and pink pepper.

name: Body Spritz
description: A playful, sheer fragranced hair and body mist designed to be experimented with, layered, and spritzed throughout the day as a quick scent escape and refresh. Available in three iconic scents. Please note: Lilyhaze Body Spritz is intended for use on the body only.

name: Daily Oil Wash
description: A gentle body cleanser that provides a deeply nourishing wash, free from soap and sulfates. Its unique oil formula transforms into a milky lather when mixed with warm water, leaving the skin feeling soft and hydrated. Now available in two iconic scents.

name: Daily Perfecting Lotion
description: A body lotion that does more than just moisturize. Now available in two iconic scents, this daily essential deeply nourishes skin while providing a subtle, healthy-looking glow. No pesky residue or dry-down time. Just a silky, lightweight lotion in a click-lock pump bottle for convenience and ease of use.

name: No. 1 Pencil
description: A creamy, long-wearing eyeliner pencil that glides on smoothly with rich, buildable, blendable color, supplying endless options for creative expression. Go bold or get subtle with demi-matte, dense pigments for crisp, true color that won’t rub, tug or transfer. This soft (but never too soft!) formula goes on in seconds and easily creates a sharp, defined line, with just enough dry-down time to blend it out for a diffused, smokey look—if that’s what you’re after.

name: Priming Moisturizer Rich
description: A luxuriously rich yet fast-absorbing face cream that delivers a surge of long-lasting hydration. The buttery texture and blend of botanical oils and glycerin melt into skin to give you a smooth, dewy finish that’s perfectly prepped for makeup.

name: Priming Moisturizer Balance
description: A fast-absorbing, lightweight gel-cream moisturizer that balances oil without over-drying or leaving a powdery finish. Immediately, thanks to Marine Extract and Niacinamide, pores appear smaller, shine is gone, and skin is hydrated and happy—with more skin-balancing benefits over time.

name: Milky Oil
description: A gentle makeup remover that melts away long-wearing and waterproof formulas—without needing to rub or tug the skin. The perfectly-proportioned blend of micellar water and weightless oil create a dual-phase formula that easily dissolves makeup, while Pro-Vitamin B5 conditions so your skin feels soft and fresh after use.

name: Full Orbit
description: A multi-benefit, 360° eye cream that tackles the concerns you care about most—immediately hydrating for up to 24 hours and depuffing while visibly brightening dark circles and smoothing the look of fine lines. Our unique lightweight, gel-cream texture (less likely to cause milia!) is fit for under eyes, on eyelids and along the orbital bone for overall fresher, brighter-looking eyes.

name: Lash Slick Duo
description: Two doses of our best-selling Lash Slick Mascara in your choice of Black, Brown, or one of each. Keep one at home and one on-the-go, so you’re never without visibly lengthened, lifted lashes.

name: Cloud Paint Duo
description: Choose your own adventure with 2 Cloud Paints of your choice. Wear them alone or tap into your inner artist and mix or layer together for a custom look.

name: Skylight
description: A skin-loving liquid highlighter for pearlescent radiance. Infused with Complexion-Inspired Micro Pearls, this buildable formula delivers long-lasting radiance that is non-sticky, non-tacky and never streaky.

name: Stretch Face Brush
description: The curved shape glides across the contours of your face for an easy, streak-free finish. With short, dense, super-soft bristles for buffing, a targeted tip for those hard-to-blend areas, and swivel cover—it’s your new grab-and-go-to face brush.

name: Milky Jelly Cleansing Balm
description: A nourishing and transformative gel-balm cleanser that gently dissolves makeup, SPF and impurities. Massage onto dry skin, add water to emulsify and rinse or gently wipe away with a clean, damp cloth for a soft and hydrated canvas.

name: Super Glow
description: A lightweight, nourishing serum formulated with 5% Vitamin C derivative and Magnesium PCA. These ingredients team up to even skin tone, improve the appearance of dark spots, and replenish moisture for recharged, refreshed and glowy skin.

name: Super Bounce
description: A fast-absorbing, super refreshing serum with a soothing combo of 2% Hyaluronic Acid Complex and Pro-Vitamin B5. Beneath the skin, this one-two punch gets to work, deeply hydrating on multiple layers for a visibly smooth, soft (and never sticky) canvas.

name: Super Pure
description: A daily vitamin and mineral duo of Zinc PCA and 5% Niacinamide (the perfect amount to be effective without irritating skin). This double dose nourishes skin for visibly smoother texture, smaller-looking pores, and improved clarity.

name: Futuredew Solid
description: Say hello to skin-loving illumination. A creamy, oil-serum illuminating stick that instantly melts on the skin for a seamless, light-reflecting glow. Swipe it on cheekbones, nose bridge and brow bones for a refreshed dew that lasts.

name: Birthday Cake Candle
description: Sweeten your space with this 10th anniversary exclusive candle, inspired by our beloved Birthday Balm Dotcom flavor and housed in a custom-molded glass jar with a chrome finish.

name: Deodorant Refillable Case
description: A case for your refillable Deodorant. Re-up on your signature scent or pop a new one into this refillable case. Available in three signature scents (Sandstone, Glossier You and Orange Blossom Neroli) plus Unscented, our refillable deodorant will outdo any odor.

name: Deodorant Refill Stick
description: 2024 Allure Best of Beauty Award-Winner. A refill for your Deodorant case. Re-up on your signature scent or pop in a new one. Formulated without aluminum, baking soda, exfoliating acids or water—aka things that can cause bad odor, disrupt the skin’s pH level and cause irritation—our Deodorant keeps it gentle (but mighty!) with ingredients that work for every underarm. Available in three signature scents (Sandstone, Glossier You and Orange Blossom Neroli) plus Unscented, these refill sticks will outdo any odor.

name: Solution
description: A daily skin-perfecting exfoliator that transforms the look and feel of your complexion by gently “ungluing” dull, dead skin and sweeping it away. With everyday use, a 10% blend of exfoliating acids help improve the appearance of uneven texture, visibly reduce the look of blemishes, and refine the appearance of enlarged pores for smoother, softer, glowier-looking skin.

name: Lidstar
description: This soft, glistening eyeshadow creates a sheer, shimmering veil of color—locking onto lids and lasting all day without creasing. Ultrafine pigments float through a buttery base for a silky, blendable formula that swipes on seamlessly and maintains its pretty, glistening look long after it settles. Available in 8 shades with different pearls, flecks, and special effects for the lit-from-within, multi-dimensional glow of your dreams.

name: Body Hero Exfoliating Bar
description: Our ergonomically-designed, no-mess body scrub bar fits in the palm of your hand and sloughs away dead skin and dryness to reveal baby-smooth skin. Finely-milled, biodegradable Bamboo Powder provides powerful (yet never painfully powerful) scrub action that exfoliates for skin that feels instantly softer and smoother. Sunflower Seed Oil and Aloe Leaf juice lock in moisture, so you’ll never feel that stripped soapy feeling, while Orange Blossom Neroli Blend adds the fresh, sparkling scent of pear, mandarin, and cypress. Don’t forget to inhale, exhale, and relax for an instant shower (or bubble bath) upgrade.

name: Glossier You Solid Refill
description: The solid refill of our ultimate personal fragrance, Glossier you. The solid formula is softer and more intimate, with an alcohol-free, anhydrous wax base that quite literally melts into skin and holds the fragrance close, almost like it’s a part of you. Instead of being surrounded by a cloud of scent, you get friendly reminders throughout the day when you catch a whiff of your wrist or neck of your sweater—creamy, warm, sparkling notes of ambrox, ambrette, musk, iris root and pink pepper.

name: Sharpener
description: Keep your essentials in prime condition with this eye + lip liner sharpener featuring a German-engineered blade for smooth, precise lines every time.

name: Terrazzo Hoodie
description: Extra-plush and cut for a relaxed, slightly oversized fit, our Terrazzo Hoodie is back for a limited time. Like our other hoodies, it features a super-soft, fleecy inside, our signature Glossier logo on the front, and a subtle speckled pattern.

name: Limited Edition Embroidered Cream Hoodie
description: Inspired by all the things we love about summer (evening walks, beach bonfires, city rooftops…shall we continue?), our iconic Embroidered Hoodie is now available in a limited-edition cream colorway. Like our other hoodies, it’s plush and cozy with a super-soft, fleecy inside, an embroidered Glossier logo on the front, and a pink and red G-logo patch on the sleeve. We know, a hoodie for the summer sounds…hot but this time around, we wanted to create something for those slightly-chilly evenings when you want to stay outside just a little bit longer.

name: Three Eyed Smiley Mug
description: Enjoy a sip of instant joy with this stackable Glossier pink ceramic mug, featuring our logo and Three Eyed Smiley. Ideal for tea, coffee or storing your favorite makeup products!

name: Glossier Sweatshirt
description: Here’s the story: originally made for our team at Glossier HQ (because our offices can get pretty chilly), then everyone started asking for them. So, we made more. With a classic crewneck, raglan sleeves, and super soft, plush fleece interior—it feels like something you’ve worn (and loved) forever. Plus, now we can all match!

name: Field Greens Blanket
description: Big enough to cuddle under, cozy enough to want to keep all to yourself. Our 100% cotton knitwear blanket (originally a holiday gift for the gTEAM!) is back for all your lounging needs. This super soft (and never itchy) blanket will be loved by you and your pets.

name: Glossier Utility Bag
description: Flaunt both storage and style with this sturdy, strapped canvas bag embossed with Glossier’s birthplace and year— New York, New York, 2014. Carry all and carry on with seven durable pockets for products, personal belongings and everything in between.

name: Duffle Bag
description: Meet your new go-to gym bag, long-weekend satchel, carry-everything, chic-and-sporty duffle. It comes equipped with a single main compartment, two interior pockets, a side pocket, and an adjustable, detachable shoulder strap. A desert rose colorway, with a sand-colored bag, peach straps and burgundy Glossier logo.

name: Classic Cap
description: Say hello to our brand new caps! An everyday staple featuring a pre-curved visor and an embroidered design. Available in two variations.

name: Full Body Routine
description: One scent, three ways to wear it. Complete with our Daily Oil Wash, Daily Perfecting Lotion and Body Spritz, this full-body trio is designed to be layered. Just cleanse, lock in moisture and finish with our lightweight hair-and-body mist. Available in two iconic scents.

name: The Cheek Kit
description: A perfect duo curated for a dewy glow. Apply our oil-serum hybrid, Futuredew, for a lit-from-within glow, then top off your look with Cloud Paint, our seamless, gel-cream cheek color, for a natural-looking flush or sun-hugged definition.

name: The Glossier You Routine
description: Two iconic Glossier products to make your routine a little more luxe. Wear them solo or layer them together for a long-lasting fragrance experience.

name: The Lip Kit
description: Build the ultimate combo with Lip Line, our enhancing lip pencil, and Ultralip, our high-shine lipstick for a hint of moisturizing color.

name: Care Package
description: Treat yourself or a loved one to this ultra-nourishing duo. Because nothing says ‘I love you’ quite like our do-everything lip balm and our supercharged hand cream infused with Glossier You.

name: The Brow Kit
description: New Boy Brow Arch shapes and defines brows with a 2-in-1 custom tip shape— a precision edge for hair-like flicks and flat edge to fill sparse areas. Pair with our legendary face-framing Boy Brow for flexible hold + a total brow look.

name: Cloud Paint Cheek Brush
description: A dual-ended, portable and retractable synthetic brush designed for our powder and gel-cream blushes. The tapered brush end is perfect for blending Cloud Paint Plush Blush. While the opposite end mimics fingertips with a soft and non-absorbent silicone tip, making it perfect for patting on Cloud Paint!

name: Wavy Tray
description: Bring a bit of our world to yours with this 10th anniversary exclusive acrylic tray. A beloved staple from our stores, it’s perfect for displaying your makeup or holding your favorite cleansing bar.
